Managed Security Services
X
X
Seamless and cost-effective management of security operations provided in an as-a-service model.
Wipro’s managed security services include advanced cyber defense centres, cybersecurity platforms and managed security infrastructure and operations. Wipro’s Managed Security Services (MSS) differentiates through a global scale augmented by localization and regional presence, where our highly experienced cybersecurity talent pool is backed by strong partnerships and venture investments. Wipro’s Cyber Defense Centers, spread across 16 locations, is powered by cutting edge technology to provide scale and cost competitiveness. We make IT and operational choices that reduce costs and improve efficiency while enhancing security capabilities.
Our MSS offers operations and management of IT security infrastructures for one or several customers through a security operations center (SOC). Typical services include security monitoring, behavior analysis, unauthorized access detection, advisory on prevention measures, penetration testing, firewall operations, anti-virus operations, IAM operation services, DLP operations, and all other operating services to provide ongoing, real-time protection without compromising business performance.
What We Do
Next Gen Cyber Command Center – AI MDR
Wipro’s 24x7 SOC and Managed Detection and Response (MDR) Service provides cyber resilience using 360’ degree threat detection and response coverage.
Managed Security Risk & Compliance
End-to-end Managed Services to transform, automate and orchestrate Risk and Compliance processes enabling effective protection, detection and response.
Managed Application Security
Create highly secure applications in compliant environments backed by deep industry expertise, best-in-class platforms and scalable processes.
Managed Digital Trust
Managed Digital Trust services and platforms to improve time to market while uncovering cyber threats and reducing enterprise costs. Build Zero Trust and Digital Identity resiliency to establish trust at scale, while detecting and preventing unusual access to data, services, software, processes and intellectual property.
Managed Cloud & Infra Security
Comprehensive Managed Cloud and Infra Security, Risk Management and Governance using Wipro’s 24x7 Cyber Defense Center and 360-degree threat detection and response coverage.
